products.name: Comfy Retro Women Jeans
products.description:
Crafted with uncompromising precision, the Comfy Retro Women Jeans embodies XEVORAS's philosophy of 'Always Rare · हटके हमेशा'.

Silhouette & Design:
• Cut in 100% Ring-Spun Cotton Heavyweight Denim Twill with a flattering comfort tailored luxury fit.

• Tailored specifically for casual everyday & modern streetwear.

Fabrication & Care:
